description: Supplying of Drugs Manufactured by the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation Directly to the Medical Supplies Division
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-11
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health to purchase the total annual requirement of Folic Acid Tablet BP 1 mg. by the Medical Supplies Division, from the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.
